name: linkedin-comment-ai
description: Privacy-first Chrome/Edge extension (MV3) to write authentic, high-signal LinkedIn & X comments and posts using any LLM provider.

scripts.check: node --check background.js && node --check content.js && node --check options.js && node --check popup.js && node --check history.js
scripts.pack: python3 -c "import zipfile; files = ['manifest.json', 'background.js', 'content.js', 'content.css', 'options.html', 'options.js', 'options.css', 'popup.html', 'popup.js', 'popup.css', 'history.html', 'history.js', 'history.css', 'README.md', 'icons/icon16.png', 'icons/icon32.png', 'icons/icon48.png', 'icons/icon128.png']; z = zipfile.ZipFile('linkedin-comment-ai.zip', 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED); [z.write(f, f) for f in files]; z.close(); print('Package built.')"
